archetypes.name: dyn-issue-list-wrapper
archetypes.rationale: Eight callers now share gh.issue_list_read with divergent field sets, limits, and ShipError translations.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect every migrated issue-list call site for correct fields, state, limit, and labels passed to gh.issue_list_read. Verify OPEN/CLOSED casefolding, camelCase closedAt/url consumption, flat-row iteration after deleting _json_documents, and that audit concurrency preflight alone degrades ShipError to an empty list while hard-fail boundaries still emit ERROR=/ISSUE_LIST_FAILED=. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
